text: As soon as it was over, Dorian rushed behind the scenes to the greenroom.
speaker: C1

text: The girl was standing there alone,
speaker: Sibyl C3

text: amongst the costumes and the lights and the greasepaint.
speaker: C2

text: She had a look of triumph on her face.
speaker: C3

text: (Dorian enters)
speaker: Stage

text: How badly I acted to-night, Dorian!
speaker: Sibyl

text: Horribly! It was dreadful.  Are you ill? You have no idea what I suffered.
speaker: Dorian

text: Dorian, you should have understood.  But you understand now, don't you?
speaker: Sibyl

text: Understand what?
speaker: Dorian

text: Why I was so bad to-night. Why I shall always be bad.  Why I shall never act well again.
speaker: Sibyl

text: You are ill, I suppose.  When you are ill you shouldn't act.  You make yourself ridiculous.  My friends were bored.  I was bored.
speaker: Dorian

text: Dorian, Dorian, before I knew you, acting was the one reality of my life. I knew nothing but shadows, and I thought them real.  You taught me what reality really is. You had made me understand what love really is. I have grown sick of shadows.  You are more to me than all art can ever be.  I heard them hissing, and I smiled. What could they know of love such as ours? I now hate the stage.  I cannot mimic the passion that burns me like fire. Even if I could do it, it would be profanation for me to play at being in love.
speaker: Sibyl

text: You have killed my love (she laughs and goes to him he pushes her away and goes to the door) Yes you have killed my love.  You used to stir my imagination.  Now you don't even stir my curiosity. I loved you because you realised the dreams of great poets and gave shape and substance to the shadows of art.  You have thrown it all away. You are shallow and stupid.  My God! how mad I was to love you!  I wish I had never laid eyes upon you!  You have spoiled the romance of my life.  Without your art, you are nothing.  I would have made you famous, splendid, magnificent.  What are you now?  A third-rate actress with a pretty face.
speaker: Dorian

text: You are not serious, Dorian? You are acting. (she moves to him)
speaker: Sibyl

text: Don’t touch me!
speaker: Dorian

text: Dorian, don't leave me! I am so sorry I didn't act well.  I will try--indeed, I will try. Don't go away from me.  I couldn't bear it.  Oh! don't go away from me.  I will work so hard and try to improve. After all, it is only once that I have not pleased you.
speaker: Sibyl

text: I am going. I don't wish to be unkind, but I can't see you again.  You have disappointed me. (he exits)
speaker: Dorian
